mapper.insert:
insert into settlement_detail (claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time) values
(#{item.claimId}, #{item.entryKind}, #{item.eventKey}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.merchantId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.sourceId}, #{item.receiverType}, #{item.receiverId}, #{item.grossAmount}, #{item.commissionAmount}, #{item.settlementAmount}, #{item.status}, #{item.failReason}, #{item.idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and status = 1 order by id desc limit 1

select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and status in (0, 1) order by id asc

select d.* from settlement_detail d join refund_application ra on ra.id = d.source_id where d.source_type = 'refund' and d.status = 1 and ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = #{registrationId} and ra.id != #{excludeRefundId} and ra.status = 1 and ra.del_flag = 0 order by d.id for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into settlement_detail (claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{claimId}, #{entryKind}, #{eventKey}, #{batchId}, #{merchantId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{grossAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{settlementAmount}, #{status}, #{failReason}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} for update
mapper.sql: and not exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id where settlement_detail.source_type = 'registration' and r.id = settlement_detail.source_id and r.owner_type = 1 and (t.end_date is null or t.end_date > date_sub(now(), interval ${@com.chengyinhub.business.support.FundsHoldPolicy@WITHDRAWABLE_AFTER_END_DAYS} day)) )
mapper.select:
select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
order by id asc
mapper.update: update settlement_detail set batch_id = #{batchId}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 0

update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where source_type = 'registration' and status = 0 and source_id in ( select id from cms_registration where owner_id = #{activityId} and owner_type = 2 and payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 ) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = settlement_detail.source_id and h.status = 0 )
update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where source_type = 'registration' and status = 0 and source_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.delete: delete from settlement_detail where source_type = 'coupon' and source_id = #{sourceId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
mapper.select: select #{merchantId} as merchant_id, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 and source_type != 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as settled_amount, coalesce(-sum(case when source_type = 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as reversal_amount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 and source_type != 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) - coalesce(-sum(case when source_type = 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as net_amount from settlement_detail where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.sql: coalesce( (select c.new_arrived from club_event_attendance_correction c where c.id = (select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = r.owner_id and c2.member_id = r.member_id)), case when exists (select 1 from club_lead_checkin ck where ck.activity_id = r.owner_id and ck.member_id = r.member_id) or exists (select 1 from cms_registration v where v.owner_type = 2 and v.owner_id = r.owner_id and v.member_id = r.member_id and v.payment_status = 2 and v.registration_status = 2 and v.verification_status = 1) or exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.member_id = r.member_id and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) then 1 else 0 end) = 1
mapper.select: select id, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, coop_order_id as coopOrderId, merchant_member_id as merchantMemberId, leader_member_id as leaderMemberId, verify_time as verifyTime from coop_group_verify where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id

select r.id as registrationId, r.order_num as orderNum, (select count(1) from cms_registration_seat s where s.registration_id = r.id and s.status = 1) as verifiedSeats from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and and not exists ( select 1 from refund_application ra where ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = r.id and ra.status = 1 and ra.del_flag = 0)
and r.id = #{registrationId}
and not exists ( select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.activity_id = r.owner_id and h.status = 0)
order by r.id for update

select count(*) from redemption rd join cms_registration r on r.id = rd.registration_id join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id and t.product_type = 2 join topic_sale_snapshot ss on ss.topic_id = t.id where rd.id = #{redemptionId} and rd.topic_id = t.id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' and a.club_id > 0 and a.club_id = t.club_id and ss.schema_version = 'CANONICAL_15_V1' and json_unquote(json_extract(ss.canonical_json, '$.completionPolicy.evidenceRule')) is not null and json_unquote(json_extract(ss.canonical_json, '$.completionPolicy.evidenceRule')) != 'FOUR_STORE_REDEEM'
select t.id from cms_activity a join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id where a.id = #{activityId} and t.product_type = 2

select o.id as coopOrderId, o.topic_id as topicId, #{activityId} as activityId, o.to_id as merchantMemberId from coop_order o join cms_activity a on a.topic_id = o.topic_id where a.id = #{activityId} and o.to_type = 'merchant' and o.status = 0 and o.del_flag = 0 and exists (select 1 from redemption rd join cms_registration r on r.id = rd.registration_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and rd.topic_id = a.topic_id and rd.merchant_id = o.to_id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE') order by o.id

select r.id as registrationId, 1 as orderNum, 1 as verifiedSeats from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and exists (select 1 from redemption rd join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id where rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.topic_id = a.topic_id and rd.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and rd.status = 'ACTIVE') and not exists (select 1 from refund_application ra where ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = r.id and ra.status = 1 and ra.del_flag = 0)
and r.id = #{registrationId}
and not exists (select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.activity_id = r.owner_id and h.status = 0)
order by r.id for update

select count(*) from redemption rd join cms_registration r on r.id = rd.registration_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and rd.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and (exists (select 1 from club_direct_merchant_receivable cr where cr.redemption_id = rd.id and cr.status in ('OPEN', 'SETTLED', 'REFUND_DUE')) or exists (select 1 from merchant_payable mp where mp.redemption_id = rd.id and mp.entry_type = 'ACCRUAL'))

select id, claim_id as claimId, merchant_id as merchantId, source_type as sourceType, source_id as sourceId, receiver_type as receiverType, receiver_id as receiverId, gross_amount as grossAmount, commission_amount as commissionAmount, settlement_amount as settlementAmount, status from settlement_detail where source_type = 'registration' and source_id = #{registrationId} and receiver_type = 'merchant' and status in (0, 1) order by id for update
mapper.update: update settlement_detail set gross_amount = gross_amount - #{fee}, settlement_amount = settlement_amount - #{fee}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and receiver_type = 'merchant' and settlement_amount >= #{fee} and gross_amount >= #{fee}
